Subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference — buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Sandra / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the items we discussed for the buying committee: 

What we showed:
- Real-time inference latency & throughput on your expected workload (multimodal GPT-style model).
- Cost projections vs. existing setup (batching + prefix caching reductions).
- Security controls: VPC options, KMS support, and audit logs.

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Sandra Lopez (CIO) — budget & final approval.
- Security lead: Mina Patel — security questionnaire / SOC2 / HIPAA attestation.
- Procurement: Tom Reynolds — contract, PO, invoicing cadence.
- Technical owner: Carlos Mendez — integration, infra, latency SLOs.

Decision criteria you called out:
1) HIPAA + SOC2 evidence (must be available prior to pilot).
2) Latency <= 200ms p95 for conversational flows.
3) Clear pricing for 24/7 dedicated capacity and burst policy.
4) Ease of rollout (canary + rollback) and telemetry for audit.

Proposed next steps:
- We’ll share the post-demo deck + SOC2 excerpt and a draft SOW (attached). (Today)
- Security team to confirm required artifacts & timeline — Mina to confirm by 5/14.
- Procurement to share redline process — Tom to confirm standard timelines and preferred PO terms by 5/17.
- Technical working session to scope integration points — propose 5/19 at 10am PT.

Please confirm or adjust owners/dates. We’re happy to accelerate any of these items if you prefer.

Attachments: Redwood_Post-Demo_Deck.pdf, SOC2_report_excerpt.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks. Procurement summary & next steps from our side: 
- Standard flow: MSA (legal review) -> SOW (scope/pricing) -> PO. Typical internal review: 7-10 business days for MSA redlines (depending on legal load).
- For initial pilot we can do a limited-term SOW and PO; if pricing/SLAs look good we’ll move to a longer term.
- Please share a clean SOW and any preferred contract language. If you have an editable MSA/SOW we’ll start redlines.

I’ve opened a DocuSign request for a preliminary MSA placeholder (link below) — please let me know if you prefer a different workflow. Also confirm your standard invoice terms and whether you can accept Aurelia’s standard net-45 PO.

Quick technical follow-up (summarized for Mina / Carlos):
- Integration: primary path is via our REST API + optional VPC peering for private deployment. We can provide a short integration runbook during the tech working session.
- Latency: with a dedicated TPU/GPU pool expected p95 is ~120-160ms for the conversational flows we demoed (given the 2k token window you mentioned). We’ll scope a perf-run during the pilot to validate.
- Data handling: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and full audit logging; SOC2 excerpt attached.

I attached the SOC2 excerpt for Mina’s review. I’m available for the technical working session on 5/19 at 10am PT as proposed.
